shell: shared/navigation.json#/shells/mobileStudentShell (bottom nav not shown on this pushed screen — consistent with ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 1's list of nav-visible screens NOT including Demo Checkout, and with the showcase's own frame, which also shows no nav row; no conflict here, unlike mobile-course-details.json)
sourceReferences: design-review-locked/Mentora Showcase.dc.html § 22 Product Preview — MOBILE PREVIEW "Demo Checkout" frame, lines 2280-2308 (verified by direct read)

layout.structure: single-column, full-width card at every mobile width, per ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 5 — header ("Demo checkout" title + back) -> lineItem card -> order summary card -> demo-payment notice -> sticky footer actions

content: arrow_back + "Demo checkout" title (lines 2284-2285) — a real title here, unlike Course Details' icon-only header
course thumbnail (96px) + title + "{instructor} · {N} lessons" (lines 2288-2290) — reuses courseCard's compact content pattern, matching demo-checkout.json's Web spec

"ORDER SUMMARY" eyebrow, "Course" / price row, "Total" / price row in heading.h3-equivalent weight (lines 2292-2296) — no discount/original-price row shown in this mockup's demo data, consistent with demo-checkout.json's Web note that this row is conditional
info.container-tinted notice: info icon + "Demo Payment" title + "No real charges or payment information required." body (lines 2297-2300) — byte-matching demo-checkout.json's Web closedFieldSet copy
full-width "Complete Demo Purchase" PrimaryButton + "Back to course" TextButton (lines 2303-2304)

closedFieldSet.rule: Same EXHAUSTIVE, CLOSED field list as demo-checkout.json (Web) — course line item, price rows, total, demo-payment notice, confirm/cancel actions. MUST NEVER contain card number, CVV, expiry, billing address, bank information, or any payment-provider logo. Confirmed by direct read: the showcase's own mobile frame contains exactly this field set and nothing more.

states.processing: confirm button's own Loading state, rest of summary static (mirrors Web)
states.error: inline 'Demo checkout could not be completed. Try again.' + Try Again (mirrors Web)

rtlBehavior: notice text and price rows follow logical start/end; total amount stays Western Arabic numerals regardless of locale (matches shared/navigation.json#/rtlMirroring/neverMirrors/numerals) — not independently re-verified live for mobile in this pass (no mobile Arabic Demo Checkout frame exists in the showcase)
themeBehavior: standard semantic token resolution — not independently re-verified live for mobile in this pass
responsiveRules: single-column card at form-width cap, every mobile width (matches demo-checkout.json's Web responsiveRules, which is already mobile-appropriate)
knownGaps: No mobile Arabic-RTL or Dark-mode frame exists in the showcase for Demo Checkout — rtlBehavior/themeBehavior above are inferred, not independently showcase-verified for this screen.

The mobile mockup's cancel action reads "Back to course" (line 2304) rather than demo-checkout.json's Web spec's plain "Cancel" label — both describe the identical behavior (return to Course Details) and neither contradicts any rank-1 IA/behavior rule, so this is noted as a literal microcopy difference only, not a conflicts[]-worthy IA disagreement.
